entities.summary: Mulgimaa is a cultural-historical region in South Estonia. Today the region encompasses Viljandi County and northwestern Valga County. Historically, Mulgimaa was divided into five parishes : Halliste, Helme, Karksi, Paistu, and Tarvastu.
